description.p: A native GNOME interface for reading, writing, creating, and browsing floppy disk images, with offline browsing for AmigaDOS, FAT12, Acorn DFS, and Commodore 1541 filesystems, automatic browsing of HFE and raw-flux containers, preservation reports, image inspection and conversion, HxC HFE track-image support, and Greaseweazle drive tools.

ul.li: Browse HFE, SCP, and A2R containers through temporary decoded images.
Offer every installed filesystem reader through the image chooser.
Improve probing and geometry discovery for non-80-cylinder formats.
Add HxC HFE v1 and v3 inspection and direct track writing.
Add HFE output for captures, conversions, and blank images.
Preserve initialized filesystems when creating blank HFE media.
